purpose: Prevent DWG ARC writer output from encoding non-finite angular parameters that cannot describe native arc geometry.

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.wireMapping: Start angle (group 50) and end angle (group 51) are encoded as BD values.

nativeContract.source: Autodesk ObjectARX AcDbArc::setStartAngle and AcDbArc::setEndAngle references
nativeContract.requirements: Both values are angular parameters in radians; negative finite angles are allowed.

implementation.behavior: DWG ARC writer admission now requires finite start and end angles as well as the existing finite positive radius check. Validation occurs before staged record publication; no arbitrary angular range was imposed.
implementation.scope: Writer admission only; input parsing remains unchanged.

generatedControls.failureRetry: Each refusal preserves a seeded destination; corrected 0.25/1.0-radian output succeeds using the same dwgRW instance and reads back both parameters with zero entity/object parse failures.
generatedControls.fixturePolicy: All records are authored by the test in scratch storage; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.

limitations: The generated controls prove bounded writer admission, failure/retry and typed readback, not source prevalence, native rendering or complete-document qualification.
The broader P6 geometry/no-loss audit remains open.
supportClaimEffect: Closes a bounded DWG ARC non-finite-angle writer gap; no broad DWG/DXF support claim is promoted.
